Yes. Motilli was formulated specifically for GLP-1 users. The ingredients are whole-food derived (celery juice extract, sodium copper chlorophyllin, FOS prebiotic fiber, whole-food vitamins) and do not interact with semaglutide, tirzepatide, or liraglutide. Take 2 gummies 30 minutes before your largest meal — the same day as your shot is fine.

", "question_2": "What's actually in Motilli?", "answer_2": "

Motilli contains four active ingredients, each chosen for a specific role:

  • Apigenin (from cold-pressed celery juice extract) — A natural prokinetic flavonoid that helps wake up the smooth muscle in your stomach wall, restoring the gastric contraction signal that GLP-1 medications suppress.
  • Sodium Copper Chlorophyllin — A stabilized form of chlorophyll that binds to hydrogen sulfide and other sulfur compounds produced by bacterial fermentation in a slowed stomach. Neutralizes rotten-egg burps at the molecular source, not just the smell.
  • FOS Prebiotic Fiber (5g per serving) — A low-bulk soluble fiber that supports downstream colon transit without adding mass to an already-bloated stomach. Gentle, no cramping, no urgency.
  • Vitamins A, C, B6, K1, and Folate (whole-food sourced) — Replaces the key nutrients GLP-1 users typically lose from eating 30% less than they used to. Sourced from whole-food extracts, not synthetic isolates.

Pectin-based gummy. Vegan, non-GMO, third-party tested. No stimulant laxatives, no harsh chemicals, no senna or magnesium.

", "question_3": "I've already tried probiotics. How is this different?", "answer_3": "

Probiotics work downstream in the colon. Your GLP-1 slowed down your stomach — six feet upstream. That's why probiotics didn't help. Motilli works on the actual organ that was shut down by the medication.

", "question_4": "When will I feel the difference?", "answer_4": "

Most users notice reduced bloating by day 2-3, sulfur burps stopping by day 4-5, and regular bowel movements by week 1-2. Full digestive reset typically by week 4.

", "question_5": "How do I take it?", "answer_5": "

2 gummies per day, 30 minutes before your biggest meal. Most users stay on Motilli for as long as they're on their GLP-1 medication.

", "question_6": "How fast is shipping?", "answer_6": "

Orders ship within 1 business day from our US warehouse. Standard delivery takes 2-4 business days. Free US shipping on orders over $45.

", "question_7": "What if it doesn't work for me?", "answer_7": "

We offer a 90-day money-back guarantee. Email us — we'll refund every dollar. You don't even have to send the bottle back. The risk is ours.
